Eski ağır sıklet dünya şampiyonu Tyson Fury, 27 Kasım'da Netflix 'te yayınlanacak 'Tyson Fury' belgeselinde şizofreni teşhisi konduğunu açıkladı. Teşhis, 2015'te Wladimir Klitschko'yu yenip şampiyon olmasının hemen ardından geldi; Fury ayrıca 2017'de bipolar bozukluk teşhisi aldığını da anlatıyor. Boksör, 11 Aralık'ta Anthony Joshua ile Cardiff'te ringe çıkmaya hazırlanıyor.
Fury, Kasım 2015'te Wladimir Klitschko'yu yenerek dünya ağır sıklet şampiyonu olmuştu. Belgeselde anlattığına göre asıl zor dönem bundan sonra başladı. Klitschko ile Ekim 2016'da yapması planlanan rövanş maçına 'tıbben dövüşmeye uygun değil' gerekçesiyle çıkamadı. Boksör o dönemde yasaklı madde ve alkol bağımlılığıyla boğuştuğunu, kilo aldığını daha önce de açıklamıştı.
Haziran 2016'da şüpheli kalp krizi nedeniyle hastaneye kaldırıldı. Sky Sports'un aktardığına göre Fury, hastanede 'radyonun kendisiyle konuşmaya başladığını' ve kafasındaki seslerin kendisini ve ailesini öldürmekle tehdit ettiğini söylüyor.
Fury, yaşadıklarını şu sözlerle tarif etti: 'Yaşadığım karanlığı kelimeler anlatamaz. Cehennem çukurlarının yaşayan bir versiyonuydu.' Bir noktada 'kapısı kilitli, duvarları kapitone bir odada' sonlanacağından yüzde 100 emin olduğunu, bunun da kendisini çok korkuttuğunu ekledi. Geceleri uyanıp kaygı krizine girdiğini, bunu aşamadığını belirten Fury, Londra'da bir psikiyatriste gittiğini söyledi: 'Bana bir sürü soru sordu, bütün kutucukları işaretledim. Depresyon, anksiyete, bipolar bozukluk.'
Paris Fury, 2008'de evlendiği Tyson'ı hastanede ziyaret ettiğinde doktorların kendisine bunun bir anksiyete atağı olduğunu söylediğini anlattı. Ancak gördüğü tablo farklıydı: 'Çok korktum, onun için korktum. Gittiğini görebiliyordum, şalteri indirmişti.'
Doktorların Fury için 'hafif şizofren' tanısı koyduğunu söyleyen Paris, 'Buna rağmen kuruşun düşmedi' diyor. Bipolar bozukluğu ise o güne kadar hiç duymamıştı: 'Biri bana bunu gerçekten anlattığında 'Vay, bu tamamen o' dedim.'
Fury'nin babası John Fury de belgeselde konuşuyor. Oğlundaki rahatsızlığın 'hep orada olduğunu' kabul eden John Fury, 'Depresif bir çocuk görmek istemedim. Gördüysem de aldırış etmedim' diyor. Ardından şunu ekliyor: 'Bu bir hastalık , korkunç bir hastalık. Ben de yaşıyorum.'
Fury, dönüm noktası olarak 2017'deki Cadılar Bayramı gecesini gösteriyor. Alkol bağımlısı olduğunu, görünüşünden utandığını ve o gece karanlıkta parlayan bir iskelet kostümü giydiğini anlatan boksör, bipolar bozukluk teşhisini de 2017'de aldığını belirtiyor.
Fury, Klitschko zaferinden üç yıl sonra, 2018'de ringlere geri döndü. Mayıs 2024'te Oleksandr Usyk'e yenilerek ağır sıklet unvanını kaybetti, Aralık 2024'teki ikinci Usyk maçının ardından da emekli olduğunu duyurdu. Geri dönüşü 2026'da yaptı ve CNN'in aktardığına göre iki galibiyet aldı.
Şimdi sırada bir başka İngiliz ağır sıklet, Anthony Joshua var. İkili 11 Aralık'ta Galler'in Cardiff kentinde karşı karşıya gelecek. Belgesel, maçtan iki hafta önce, 27 Kasım'da Netflix 'te yayınlanacak. Yönetmenliğini Lucy Wilcox'un yaptığı film , Fury'nin kariyerinin yanı sıra ruh sağlığı mücadelesini de ele alıyor.
Belgeselde 'Hayatıma bakarsanız çok başarı, çok güzel şey var' diyen Fury, sözlerini şöyle tamamlıyor: 'Ama hayatımdaki en büyük başarı ailem, çocuklarım ve eşim.' Teşhisin ilk kez kamuoyuyla paylaşıldığı belirtilirken, belgesel yayınlandığında ayrıntıların netleşmesi bekleniyor.

Başakşehirli Bertuğ Yıldırım, hayvanın kendi evinin çevresinde görüldüğünü anlattı. Çorum FK karşısında hat-trick yaptığı maçın ardından konuşan oyuncu, olayı kamptayken öğrenmişti.

İngiliz ağır sıklet boksör Tyson Fury, 2015’te Wladimir Klitschko’yu yenerek dünya şampiyonluğunu kazanmasının ardından şizofreni teşhisi aldığını açıkladı.
Netflix’in 27 Kasım’da yayınlayacağı hayatını anlatan belgesel için kamera karşısına geçen 38 yaşındaki boksör, teşhisi Haziran 2016’da kalp krizi şüphesiyle hastaneye yatırıldıktan sonra aldığını söyledi.
Tarihin en iyi ağır sıklet boksörleri arasında gösterilen Fury, o dönemi şöyle anlattı:
“Kelimeler, içinde bulunduğum karanlığı anlatmaya yetmez. Cehennem çukurunda olmaktı. Sonumun kapısı kilitli bir akıl hastanesi odasında olacağını düşündüm ve bu beni çok korkuttu.
Kaygı beni mahvediyordu. Üstesinden gelemiyordum. Tamamen tükenmiştim ve işte o zaman Londra’da psikiyatriste gittim. Bana bir sürü soru sordu, ne olduğuna bakmadan bütün kutucukları işaretledim. Depresyon, anksiyete, bipolar bozukluk…”
Fury ise hastanede radyonun kendisiyle konuştuğunu duyduğunu ve ‘İlluminati peşinde olduğu için’ eşine yalvararak hastaneden çıkarılmasını istediğini anlattı.
Hastaneden taburcu edildikten sonraysa şizofreni ve bipolar bozukluk teşhisi doğrulandı.
Klitschko zaferinden sonraki dönemde kilo alan, uyuşturucu ve alkol bağımlılığıyla mücadele eden Fury, 2017’deki Cadılar Bayramı gecesi dışarı çıktığı akşamdan ‘dönüm noktası’ diye bahsetti:
“Dışarı çıktım ve görünüşümden utandım, Şişman, perişan bir haldeydim; üzerimde karanlıkta parlayan bir iskelet kostümü ve tam yüz maskesi vardı.
Etrafıma baktım, bütün o gençleri gördüm ve ‘Dünya elimdeydi, hepsini heba ettim ve şimdi alkol bağımlısı, şişman bir enkaz oldum’ diye düşündüm.”
Fury, bunun kendisini ailesine daha çok odaklanmaya ve antrenmanlara dönmeye iten bir geri dönüşün başlangıcı olduğunu söyledi.
Bu süreç, 2020’de Deontay Wilder’ı yenerek bir dünya şampiyonluğu daha kazanmasıyla sonuçlandı.
Fury şu sıralarda, uzun zamandır beklenen ve iki İngiliz ağır sikletin karşı karşıya geleceği Anthony Joshua maçına, 11 Aralık’ta Cardiff’te çıkmak için hazırlanıyor.
Maç Netflix’ten, belgeselin çıkışından iki hafta sonra canlı yayınlanacak.

Almanya genelindeki 450'den fazla okula aynı içerikli bomba tehditleri gönderildi. Polis, tehditlerin ciddi olmadığı değerlendirmesinde bulunurken soruşturma başlatıldı.
Almanya'da yüzlerce okula bomba tehdidi içeren mesajlar gönderildi. Bild gazetesinin haberine göre, "Ölüm seni bekliyor" ifadesinin yer aldığı e-postaların tamamı aynı metinden oluşuyordu.
Freiburg polisi, ihbar hattına çok sayıda okula ilişkin bomba tehdidi geldiğini doğruladı. "İlk tespitlere göre, tehdit içerikli e-postaların ülke genelinde 450'den fazla okula gönderildiğini" belirten polis, tehditlerin kim tarafından gönderildiğinin araştırıldığını kaydetti.
Thüringen eyalet polisi de suç işleneceği yönünde tehditte bulunarak kamu huzurunun bozulması suçlamasıyla soruşturma başlatıldığını açıkladı.
Thüringen polisinden yapılan açıklamada, "bomba tehditlerinin gerçek bir tehlike oluşturmadığı" kanaatinde olunduğu belirtildi. Bu nedenle de okulların tahliye edilmemesi ve eğitime normal şekilde devam edilmesi tavsiye edildi. Polis, bu tavsiyeye rağmen bazı okulların öğrencileri evlerine gönderdiğini aktardı.
Aşağı Saksonya içişleri ve eğitim bakanlıkları da eyaletteki çok sayıda okula tehdit mesajları gönderildiğini doğruladı. Ancak bakanlıklar, tehditlerin kapsamına ilişkin ayrıntılı bilgi vermedi. Eyalet Eğitim Bakanlığı sözcüsü, okulların herhangi bir tehdit alması durumunda polisle temasa geçmeleri ve suç duyurusunda bulunmaları gerektiğini söyledi.
Geçtiğimiz günlerde İtalya'nın yanı sıra Kuzey İrlanda ve İskoçya'da da yüzlerce okula benzer tehditler gönderilmiş, çok sayıda okul tahliye edilmişti.
Benzer şekilde Avrupa'da yolcu uçaklarına yapılan bomba ihbarları ise hava ulaşımını etkilemişti.

İstanbul 'daki alışveriş, iş ve ticaret merkezlerinin otoparklarında ilk üç saatin ücretsiz olması gerekiyor. İBB Zabıta Dairesi Başkanlığı ekipleri bu kurala uyulup uyulmadığını denetliyor. Denetimlerde 50 işletmenin kurala uymadığı tespit edildi.
İstanbul 'da alışveriş, iş ve ticaret merkezlerinin otoparklarında 0-3 saat arasının ücretsiz olması, Ulaşım Koordinasyon Merkezi'nin (UKOME) mevcut kararı gereği zorunlu. İBB Zabıta Dairesi Başkanlığı ekipleri, otoparklarda bu karara uyulup uyulmadığını denetliyor. Denetimlerde 50 alışveriş, iş ve ticaret merkezinin kurala uymadığı görüldü.
Kurala uymayan işletmeler hakkında son bir haftada 655 idari yaptırım tutanağı düzenlendi. Tutanaklardaki toplam ceza tutarı 2 milyon 426 bin 775 lira oldu. 2026 yılı için idari para cezası araç başına 3 bin 705 lira olarak uygulanıyor.
İBB , işletme sahiplerine ve yönetimlerine resmi yazı göndererek UKOME kararına uymalarını istedi. Bilgilendirme çalışmalarının ve denetimlerin ardından 14 merkez, otopark giriş ve ödeme noktalarına ilk üç saatin ücretsiz olduğunu gösteren tarife listelerini astı. Vatandaşlar şikâyetlerini İBB Çözüm Merkezi'ne iletebiliyor. Tutanaklar ise ceza kararı için İBB Encümen Müdürlüğü'ne gönderiliyor.

Paul Potts was managing Port Talbot's Carphone Warehouse store at the time of his audition
Britain's Got Talent winner Paul Potts said he nearly missed his life-changing audition on the show because he had been unable to get time off from his job managing a phone shop.
The tenor shot to fame in 2007 after performing Nessun Dorma on the ITV talent show, but had unsuccessfully tried to change the date of his performance because of his shift at Port Talbot's Carphone Warehouse.
"It was only thanks to a colleague who normally didn't work Saturdays that came into cover me – otherwise I wouldn't have been there," he said.
He has since released six albums, reached the final of America's Got Talent: The Champions and inspired the Hollywood film One Chance.
"I actually almost didn't end up going," he told BBC Radio Wales' My Welsh Life.
Almost 20 years later, as he prepares for a special homecoming concert in Port Talbot, Potts said he was honoured to be "still doing what I love doing".
"The only reason why I'm still doing that is because people still support me and I'll always be forever grateful for that."
Potts's homecoming, marking 20 years since his victory on Britain's Got Talent, will be in the newly refurbished Princess Royal Theatre, now renamed Y Storfa.
The Port Talbot tenor talks Britain's Got Talent, and plans to perform again on home soil
Having seen photographs of the renovation, he said it looked like a "massive improvement", adding that investment in cultural venues was part of a wider regeneration of Port Talbot.
He described the people in Port Talbot as a big part of what made the town special, and its community spirit appealed to him.
"People have always been really self-deprecating and that suits my sense of being very well as well."

Yeşilçam 'ın tanınan isimlerinden Sibel Turnagöl, MasterChef'in 21 Kasım bölümüne konuk oldu. Son dönemde Maslak Oto Sanayi'ndeki esnaf lokantasıyla anılan 58 yaşındaki oyuncunun görünümü sosyal medyada övgü topladı. Turnagöl, ekranlara dönüp dönmeyeceği sorusuna da 'Ben de özledim' diye yanıt verdi.
Uzun süredir ekranlardan uzak duran Sibel Turnagöl, TV8'de yayınlanan MasterChef Türkiye 'nin 21 Kasım akşamki bölümünde konuk olarak yer aldı.
Oyuncunun yıllar sonra kameraların karşısına geçmesi, özellikle onu Yeşilçam filmlerinden hatırlayan izleyicilerin gözünden kaçmadı. Turnagöl'ün programda yer alması kısa sürede sosyal medyanın gündemine oturdu.
Turnagöl'ün son dönemdeki gündemi ise ekrandan oldukça uzaktı. Oyuncu, Maslak Oto Sanayi'nde işlettiği esnaf lokantasıyla konuşuluyordu. 2023 yılında açılan lokantanın menüsünde İzmir köfte, orman kebabı ve et sote gibi ev yemekleri yer alıyor. Menüdeki fiyatlar da kısa süre önce dikkat çekmişti.
MasterChef bölümünün ardından sosyal medyada Turnagöl'ün görüntüleri paylaşıldı. Yorumlarda öne çıkan ortak nokta, oyuncunun doğal görünümü oldu. 'Doğal yaşlanmış', 'Estetiksiz gibi ne güzel' ve 'Vay be kadın aynı kalmış' gibi yorumlar öne çıktı. Kullanıcılar, Turnagöl'ün yıllar sonra bile tanınır kalmasını ve estetik müdahale izlenimi vermeyen görünümünü takdirle karşıladı.
Ekranlara dönüşüyle ilgili sorular üzerine konuşan Turnagöl, bu konuda bir çalışma yürüttüğünü söyledi: 'Mustafa Bey ile çalışıyoruz. Böyle çok gönlümüze göre bir şey olduğu zaman inşallah olacak. Ben de özledim.'
Oyuncu, projenin ayrıntısına ya da ne zaman ekranlara geleceğine dair bir bilgi vermedi. Ancak bu sözler, Turnagöl'ü yeniden bir dizide ya da filmde görmek isteyen hayranları için umut verici oldu.
Sibel Turnagöl, 16 yaşında katıldığı bir yarışmada 'Mankenler Kraliçesi' seçilerek adını duyurdu. Ardından Yeşilçam 'da rol almaya başladı.
Kadir İnanır 'la 'Sen Türkülerini Söyle' filminde oynayan Turnagöl, ' Bebek ', 'Skandal' ve 'Günah Tohumu' filmlerinde de yer aldı. 'Yasemin', 'Bana Sevgiyi Anlat' ve 'Asla Unutma' dizilerinde rol alan oyuncu, televizyonda sunuculuk da yaptı.

İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyesinden yapılan açıklamaya göre, İBB Zabıta Dairesi Başkanlığı, Ulaşım Koordinasyon Merkezinin (UKOME) yürürlükteki kararı doğrultusunda İstanbul genelindeki alışveriş, iş ve ticaret merkezi otoparklarındaki denetimlerini sürdürüyor.
İBB ekipleri yaptıkları denetimlerde, bu merkezlerin otoparklarında ilk üç saatlik (0-3 saat) kullanımın ücretsiz olması gerekirken 50 alışveriş, iş ve ticaret merkezinin bu kurala uymadığını tespit etti.
Denetimlerde son bir hafta içinde kurala uymayan ve İstanbulluları mağdur eden işletmelere yönelik 655 adet idari yaptırım tutanağı düzenlendi.
Bu kapsamda toplam 2 milyon 426 bin 775 lira tutarında cezai işlem uygulandı.
İBB, kurala aykırı uygulama yapan işletmecilere ve yönetimlere, UKOME kararına uygun davranmaları gerektiğini bildiren resmi yazılar gönderdi.
Yürütülen bilgilendirme ve denetim çalışmaları sonucunda 14 alışveriş ve ticaret merkezi, ilk üç saatlik otopark kullanımının ücretsiz olduğunu gösteren tarife listelerini otopark girişlerine ve ödeme noktalarına asarak uygulamalarını mevzuata uygun hale getirdi.
İstanbul'da alışveriş ve ticaret merkezi otoparklarında ilk üç saat ücretsiz uygulamasına aykırı bir durumla karşılaşan İstanbullular, İBB Çözüm Merkezine şikayette bulunabiliyor.
Bu kurala aykırı şekilde ücret talep eden işletmeler hakkında İBB Zabıta ekipleri tespit tutanağı düzenliyor.
Tutanaklar, idari para cezası kararı alınmak üzere İBB Encümen Müdürlüğüne bildiriliyor. 2026 yılı itibarıyla araç başına 3 bin 705 lira idari para cezası uygulanıyor.

Gökyüzü meraklıları, kasım ayının son günlerinde dikkat çekici bir doğa olayına tanıklık edecek.
23 ve 24 Kasım gecesi gözlemlenebilecek dolunay, hem geleneksel adı hem de Dünya'ya yakın konumuyla öne çıkıyor.
Kasım dolunayı, Kuzey Amerika'da kunduzların yaklaşan soğuk kış aylarına hazırlanmak için yoğun faaliyet gösterdiği döneme denk geldiğinden "Kunduz Ayı" (Beaver Moon) diye adlandırılıyor.
Süper Ay, dolunayın Ay'ın Dünya çevresindeki eliptik yörüngesinde gezegenimize en yakın olduğu dönemlere denk gelmesiyle ortaya çıkıyor.
Ay'ın Dünya'ya uzaklığı yıl boyunca değiştiğinden bazı dolunaylar diğerlerine göre biraz daha büyük ve parlak görünüyor.
Ancak uzmanlara göre bu fark, çoğu zaman çıplak gözle kolayca ayırt edilemiyor.
Öte yandan Ay, ufuk çizgisine yakın olduğunda olduğundan daha büyük ve turuncu görünebiliyor. Bu durumun büyüklükle ilgili kısmı, "Ay yanılsaması" olarak bilinen optik bir algıdan kaynaklanıyor.
Kasım ayındaki dolunay, Şubat 2027'ye kadar art arda gerçekleşecek dört süper ayın ilki olacak.
Kunduz Süper Ayı, Türkiye'nin de bulunduğu Kuzey Yarımküre'de gün batımı civarında doğu ufkundan yükselecek.
Gece boyunca güney gökyüzünde ilerleyecek olan Ay, ertesi sabah gün doğumu civarında batı ufkundan kaybolacak.
Gökyüzü olayını izlemek isteyenlerin gün batımından hemen sonra doğu ufkunun açıkça görülebildiği, yüksek binalardan ve yoğun ışık kirliliğinden uzak bir noktaya gitmesi öneriliyor.
Ay'ın ufuktan yükseldiği ilk saatlerde daha büyük ve turuncu görünmesi de mümkün.
Güney Yarımküre'de ise dolunay yine doğudan yükselecek ancak gece boyunca gökyüzünün kuzey kesiminde ilerleyecek.
Bu yılki Kunduz Süper Ayı'nın bir başka özelliği, gökyüzünde iki önemli yıldız kümesinin yakınında görülecek olması.
Dolunay, Ülker ve Hyades yıldız kümelerine gökyüzünde yakın bir konumda bulunacak.
Her iki yıldız kümesi de Boğa Takımyıldızı bölgesinde yer alıyor.
Ancak dolunayın güçlü parlaklığı, bu yıldız kümelerinin çıplak gözle görülmesini zorlaştırabilir.

Kasım ayının Süper Ay'ı, 24 Kasım Salı günü Boğa takımyıldızındaki Pleiades yıldız kümesinin yalnızca 0,9 derece yakınından geçecek. Halk arasında Yedi Kız Kardeş olarak bilinen küme ile Ay'ın bu buluşması, haftanın en dikkat çekici gök olayı sayılıyor. Aynı hafta Mars, Venüs ve Uranüs de gökyüzünde öne çıkacak.
Haftanın ilk gözlem fırsatı 23 Kasım Pazartesi akşamı ortaya çıkıyor. Hava karardıktan sonra doğu yönüne bakıldığında, neredeyse dolunay evresindeki Ay, Boğa takımyıldızındaki Pleiades kümesinin yakınında görülebilecek. Ay'ın parlaklığı kümedeki sönük yıldızların seçilmesini zorlaştırsa da en parlak üyeler Ay'ın çevresinde fark edilebilecek.
Asıl buluşma ise 24 Kasım Salı günü gerçekleşecek. Kasım dolunayı, Ay'ın Dünya'ya en yakın olduğu yörünge noktası olan yerberi konumuna yakın oluşuyor ve bu nedenle Süper Ay olarak anılıyor. Dolunay, Pleiades kümesinin 0,9 derece kuzeyinden geçerken gökyüzünde haftanın en dikkat çekici manzaralarından birini oluşturacak.
25 Kasım Çarşamba sabahı, Güneş doğmadan yaklaşık bir saat önce doğu yönüne bakıldığında Mars ile Regulus yan yana görülecek. Aslan takımyıldızının en parlak yıldızı olan mavimsi Regulus ile kızıl renkli Mars, gökyüzünde dikkat çekici bir renk kontrastı oluşturacak. Jüpiter de parlaklığıyla bu iki gök cisminin yakınında öne çıkacak. Aynı gün Uranüs karşı konumuna ulaşacak, ancak bu gezegeni gözlemlemek için büyük dürbün ya da teleskop gerekecek.
27 Kasım Cuma günü ise Venüs sabah gökyüzünde en parlak görünümüne ulaşacak. Güneş doğmadan yaklaşık 45 dakika önce doğu-güneydoğu yönüne bakıldığında gezegen kolayca fark edilebilecek. Dünya'ya görece yakın konumu ve ışığı güçlü biçimde yansıtan yoğun bulutlu atmosferi sayesinde Venüs, sabah saatlerinin en dikkat çekici cisimlerinden biri olacak.
Süper Ay ifadesi, dolunayın her zamankinden çok daha büyük görüneceği beklentisini doğurabiliyor. Oysa aradaki fark sanıldığından küçük. Dolunay yerberi civarında gerçekleştiğinde Ay, ortalama bir dolunaya kıyasla yaklaşık yüzde 7-10 daha büyük ve yüzde 15 daha parlak görünebiliyor. Bu fark çıplak gözle her zaman kolayca anlaşılmıyor, ancak özellikle Ay doğarken daha etkileyici bir görüntü ortaya çıkıyor.
Ay'ın ufka yakın konumdayken olduğundan büyük algılanmasının nedeni ise 'Ay yanılsaması' olarak bilinen optik etki. Bu durum Ay'ın gerçek boyutundan değil, insan beyninin ufuk çizgisindeki nesneleri algılama biçiminden kaynaklanıyor.
Kasım ayının sonlarına doğru kış gökyüzü de belirginleşmeye başlıyor. Akşam saatlerinde güneydoğuda yükselen Orion takımyıldızı kolayca fark ediliyor. Orion'un üzerinde Boğa, sol tarafında İkizler, altında ise Sirius yer alıyor. Orion, Boğa, Arabacı, İkizler ve Büyük Köpek takımyıldızlarının parlak yıldızlarıyla şekillenen bu geniş desen 'Kış Altıgeni' olarak biliniyor. Haftanın takımyıldızı ise Perseus. Cassiopeia ile Boğa arasında bulunan bu takımyıldız, akşam saatlerinde kuzeydoğuya bakılarak aranabiliyor. Cassiopeia'nın W harfine benzeyen şeklinden Boğa'ya uzanan hayali bir çizgi izlendiğinde Perseus'un yıldızlarına ulaşılabiliyor.
24 Kasım'daki Süper Ay'ın ardından Ay her gece biraz daha küçülecek ve gökyüzünde daha geç saatlerde doğacak. Böylece ayın sonuna doğru yıldız gözlemi için daha karanlık akşamlar geri dönecek. Aralık ayında ise 14-15 Aralık gecelerinde zirveye ulaşacak Geminid meteor yağmuru ve 21 Aralık'ta yaşanacak kış gündönümü, gözlemcilerin takvimine eklenecek.

Hollanda ekibi NEC Nijmegen, Emre Mor ile yolların ayrıldığını açıkladı. 29 yaşındaki milli futbolcu, profesyonel kariyerine geçici olarak ara verme kararı aldı. Bir dönem Türk futbolunun en çok konuşulan yeteneklerinden biri olan Mor, kararının nedenlerini sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamayla paylaştı.
NEC Nijmegen, Emre Mor ile yolların ayrıldığını resmen duyurdu. Hollanda kulübünden yapılan açıklamada, tecrübeli futbolcunun profesyonel futbol kariyerine geçici olarak ara verme kararı aldığı belirtildi. Bir dönem Türk futbolunun en çok konuşulan yetenekleri arasında yer alan 29 yaşındaki Mor, bu kararla birlikte sahalardan bir süre uzak kalacak.
Emre Mor, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada futbolun çocukluk hayali olduğunu vurguladı. Son dönemde yaşadığı sağlık sorunları nedeniyle kendisine zaman ayırması gerektiğini belirten milli futbolcu, açıklamasında şu ifadeleri kullandı:
“Küçüklüğümden beri tek bir hayalim vardı: Profesyonel futbolcu olmak. Bu hayali gerçekleştirebilmek benim için her şey demekti. Her zaman çok sevdiğim bu spor için elimden gelenin en iyisini yapmaya çalıştım. Ancak son zamanlarda bazı sağlık sorunlarıyla karşılaştım. Artık vücudumu dinlemem, sınırlarıma saygı duymam ve sağlığımı öncelikli tutmam gereken bir noktaya geldim. Bu nedenle, profesyonel futboldan geçici olarak uzaklaşıp kendime odaklanmak için zor bir karar verdim. Futbola olan sevgim asla değişmeyecek ve geleceğin bana neler getireceği konusunda umudumu koruyorum.”
Futbola Danimarka'da başlayan ve genç yaşlarda A Milli olan Emre Mor, Galatasaray , Fenerbahçe , Dortmund, Celta Vigo ve Olympiakos gibi dev kulüplerde forma giymişti.

Bir dönem milli takım forması da giyen Emre Mor, futbola ara verdiğini ve sağlığına odaklanacağını duyurdu.
Hollanda Birinci Futbol Ligi’nde (Eredivisie) NEC Nijmegen forması giyen 29 yaşındaki futbolcu, Instagram hesabından paylaşımında “Sağlığımla ilgili yıllar süren zorlu sınavların ardından şimdilik profesyonel futbola ara vermek gibi zor bir karar aldım” yazdı.
Hollanda kulübü de futbolcuyla karşılıklı anlaşarak yolların ayrıldığını duyurdu.
Emre Mor bu yaz NEC Nijmegen’le iki yıllık sözleşme imzalamış, yedi maçta forma giymişti.
“Gönlüm hala oynamaktan yana ama bedenim şu an başka bir ihtiyacı olduğunu söylüyor” diyen futbolcu, bir gün sahalara geri döneceği umudunu kurduğunu belirtti. “Bu hayal ettiğim veda değil. Ve umarım bu bir veda bile değildir” dedi.
Emre Mor kariyerine parlak bir başlangıç yapmış, 19 yaşındayken Danimarka’nın Nordsjaelland kulübünden 9,75 milyon avro bonservis bedeliyle Alman kulübü Borussia Dortmund’a transfer olmuştu.
O yaz 2016 Avrupa Futbol Şampiyonası’nda Türkiye forması giyen futbolcunun Dortmund macerası bir sezon sürmüştü.
2017 yazında 13 milyon avro bedelle İspanyol ekibi Celta Vigo’ya transfer olan Emre Mor; Galatasaray, Olympiakos, Karagümrük, Fenerbahçe ve Eyüpspor’da forma giymiş, son olarak Eredivisie’nin yolunu tutmuştu.

Emre Kınay , kızının yeni yaşını kutlarken Duru Kınay'ın büyümüş hali ve annesi Emine Ün'e olan benzerliği dikkat çekti. Ünlü oyuncunun kızına yazdığı mesaj ise yürekleri ısıttı.
Oyuncu Emre Kınay ile eski manken ve oyuncu Emine Ün'ün 2003 yılında başlayan evliliklerinden dünyaya gelen kızları Duru Kınay, 22. yaşını kutladı. 2009 yılında yollarını ayıran çift, ayrılıklarının ardından kızları için iletişimlerini sürdürdü. Gözlerden uzak büyüyen Duru Kınay, son görüntüsüyle dikkatleri üzerine çekti. Genç kızın özellikle annesi Emine Ün'e olan benzerliği dikkat çekti. Yüz hatları ve doğal güzelliğiyle annesinin gençlik yıllarını hatırlatan Duru, görenlerden beğeni topladı.
Kızının doğum gününü unutmayan Emre Kınay, 23 Kasım 2004 tarihinin hayatındaki en özel günlerden biri olduğunu belirterek duygularını dile getirdi. It was a record-breaking occasion in more ways than one. David Moyes made history for Everton, edging clear of Harry Catterick by overseeing his 593rd game in charge of the club, but calamitous defending ruined the Scot’s evening and defeat to Brentford was inevitable after James Tarkowski received his first red card in 351 Premier League appearances.
Those in Tarkowski’s corner will claim the Everton captain’s tackle on Yehor Yarmoliuk would not have been a foul back in the day. This, though, was not a “game’s gone” moment. Not that sort of player? The reality is Tarkowski’s back catalogue features plenty of orange card tackles, meaning there was always likely to come a time when his luck ran out.
Everton, whose passive performance denied them the chance to go fifth, should not bother complaining about Matthew Donohue’s intervention from Stockley Park after Tarkowski went in on Yarmoliuk with his studs raised late in the first half. It was the defender’s first red since he was playing for Brentford in the Championship and it had no great bearing on the result. Brentford led 2-0 before their former player went off, Keane Lewis-Potter’s third and fourth goals of the season putting them in control, and dominated from start to finish.
Keith Andrews, a young coach who will have done something right if he comes close to matching Moyes’s longevity, revelled in his side moving sixth thanks to an outstanding display. Moyes has been around long enough to know the top flight has rarely been this open but on this evidence Brentford look likelier than Everton to upset the established order.
It was a drubbing, a cracking third from Vitaly Janelt followed by Fábio Carvalho making it 4-0 in added time, and made clear that Brentford have the tools to challenge for European qualification.
With Igor Thiago unavailable after his controversial red card against Brighton it fell to Callum Wilson to lead the line for Brentford. Everton were unsettled by Wilson’s movement and were strangely muted. They sat in a low block but were not compact, were careless in possession and did not deal with Brentford’s wing play and midfield interchanges.
Jaidon Anthony, Mikkel Damsgaard and Michael Kayode had chances before Everton cracked. They were caught out by a long ball down the left and were undone when a poor clearing header led to a moment of brilliance from Anthony, the winger’s cushioned touch with the outside of his right foot running for Lewis-Potter to beat Jordan Pickford thanks to a deflection off Jarrad Branthwaite.
Brentford love to make the most of Lewis-Potter’s attacking instincts after converting him into a left-back. He joined as a winger and his runs are always a threat but Everton did not pay close enough attention. They were abysmal in the first half and faced more pressure when Vitaliy Mykolenko conceded a free-kick after losing Dango Ouattara. Damsgaard crossed, Everton were all at sea and Lewis-Potter scored via another deflection, this time off Thierno Barry.
Everton were dour. They sought a lifeline through Harrison Armstrong, Caoimhín Kelleher tipping the midfielder’s shot over, but composure eluded them. Tarkowski, seemingly rattled by the barracking from the home crowd, was off after storming into a challenge on Yarmoliuk. The initial call was a yellow but Tarkowski’s boot was high, the follow-through looked cynical and the force was excessive, convincing Craig Pawson to show a red after a VAR review.
“I don’t think you can tackle like that in this day and age,” Andrews said. Moyes was honest, admitting that Tarkowski’s boot was high. “I can see why the decision went against us,” Everton’s manager said.
Everton adjusted after going down to 10, Merlin Röhl going to right-back, and Barry’s header drew a superb save from Kelleher just before half-time. Brentford had to switch on. They were intense at the start of the second half and Ouattara nodded wide from Damsgaard’s cross.
Moyes had introduced Jack Grealish for Tyrique George. Yet Brentford recognised the threat and killed Everton off when Janelt used his left foot to belt a formidable shot past Pickford from 30 yards.
“We didn’t play well,” Moyes said. “It was really not like us. I’ve got no complaints with the players. They’ve done a brilliant job until now. Tonight’s performance was not excusable.”
Everton were outplayed on every metric. They were lucky Brentford waited so long to score a fourth, Carvalho coming on to round off the humiliation by bundling in a corner from close range.

Report and free match highlights from the Premier League clash between Brentford and Everton at the Gtech Community Stadium on Monday night; Keane Lewis-Potter scores twice and James Tarkowski sent off as Bees beat Toffees.
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Keane Lewis-Potter’s first-half double set Brentford on their way to a comprehensive 4-0 Premier League win over 10-man Everton.
For David Moyes it was a record-setting night to forget. His 593rd game in charge of Everton, more than any other Toffees manager, ended in misery, as James Tarkowski's red card at 2-0 down left them with no hope of a comeback at the Gtech Community Stadium on Monday night.
Vitaly Janelt added a third for Brentford, while Fabio Carvalho came off the bench to score a fourth, as they moved up to sixth in the table, a point above Everton who slipped to ninth.
It was a deserved breakthrough for Brentford midway through the first half. A lovely touch from Jaidon Anthony teed up Lewis-Potter, who saw his strike deflect past Jordan Pickford.
Four minutes later it was 2-0. This time it came from a free-kick as the ball fell to Lewis-Potter. His first effort was blocked, but he got a second bite at it, and again a deflection from his strike took the ball away from the Everton goalkeeper.
It got worse for the Toffees before the break, too. Tarkowski was first given a yellow card for his follow-through challenge on Yehor Yarmolyuk, before a VAR check saw the referee upgrade it to red.
Moyes introduced Jack Grealish at the start of the second half, his first appearance since being dropped from the squad last month, but it would make minimal difference.
Janelt's rocket on 67 minutes added a Brentford third, as he picked out the top corner from 25 yards, while substitute Carvalho prodded in from a corner in stoppage time to add the icing to the cake.

England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales will jointly host the 2035 Women's World Cup, Fifa has confirmed.
It will be the first time a football World Cup has been held in the United Kingdom since the men's tournament in 1966.
The four countries were the only bidders for the tournament, and were ratified as co-hosts at a specially arranged virtual meeting from Fifa's Zurich headquarters.
The tournament will consist of 104 matches contested by 48 teams over 39 days.
The 'All Together' bid included a proposal to use 19 venues, with 14 in England, one in Northern Ireland, two in Scotland and two in Wales.
Monday's special meeting of Fifa's Congress also approved the joint bid by Mexico, the United States, Costa Rica and Jamaica to host the 2031 finals, which will be the first to feature 48 teams.
The news comes on the same day the UK government announced a vision for one million more girls to play, watch or be in leadership roles in sport by the time the tournament takes place.
England failed to win the right to host the men's World Cups in 2006 and 2018, and a proposed UK and Ireland bid for the 2030 tournament was abandoned.
But England and Scotland hosted matches at the men's Euros in 2021, and England staged the women's European Championship in 2022, which the Lionesses won.
England, Scotland, Wales, and the Republic of Ireland will jointly host the men's European Championship in 2028.
Mark Bullingham, chief executive of the Football Association, said: "Hosting Euro 2022 allowed us to change the game in our country, by creating a generation of aspirational role models and growing demand from women and girls to play.
"Hosting a World Cup would give us the chance to build on that across all four nations."
The English stadiums included in the 2035 bid are: Villa Park, The Amex, Ashton Gate, Elland Road, Hill Dickinson Stadium, Emirates Stadium, Selhurst Park, Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, Wembley, Etihad Stadium, St James' Park, the City Ground, the Stadium of Light and Old Trafford.
If Manchester United's proposed new Old Trafford stadium does not go ahead, it would still be considered in its current form.
Cardiff City Stadium and Principality Stadium are the two Welsh venues, with Easter Road in Edinburgh and Hampden Park in Glasgow in Scotland.
Northern Ireland missed out on co-hosting the men's Euros in 2028 after the UK government said in 2024 it would not provide funding to redevelop Casement Park in time - but a redeveloped Windsor Park is set to stage matches in 2035.
A further three stadiums could be added - Birmingham's new Powerhouse Stadium, Wrexham's redeveloped Racecourse Ground, and a potential new Chelsea ground - which would take the tournament to 16 cities and 22 venues.
Fifa is yet to decide whether all four co-hosts will qualify automatically.
The Principality Stadium in Cardiff is one of two Welsh venues, along with the Cardiff City Stadium
The participation of women and girls in football has risen by 2.3m since the Women's European Championship was held in England in 2022.
However, women remain significantly underrepresented in leadership positions.
Only a quarter of chief executive, chair or performance director roles in major UK sports are held by women and only 12% of sports federations are led by a female.
Noel Mooney, the chief executive of the Football Association of Wales, said: "This is a proud day for Welsh football.
"We've put forward Wrexham and Cardiff as host cities, and it's exciting to think what a World Cup could bring to both cities and the communities around them.
"In Llunio Cymru - our 10-year strategy - we've set ourselves the ambition of reaching the knockout stages in 2035. Some of the players who could take us there are learning the game at clubs across Wales today. Our job is to make sure that wherever a girl grows up in Wales, she can find a team close to home, have a coach who helps her develop and see a route to the Cymru shirt."
Irish Football Association chief executive Patrick Nelson said the event "would be felt in every club and every age group, in every part of the country".
"Our young players would grow up having watched the best in the world play at home, and there is no substitute for that," he added.
Scottish Football Association chief executive Ian Maxwell said hosting the tournament would be "the most significant thing to happen to the women's and girls' game in Scotland".
He added: "The impact would go far beyond just the matches themselves. The level of investment into coaching, facilities and player pathways in the years beforehand will shape the future of the game for the generations to come."
Fifa's evaluation, published earlier this month, rated the bid 4.3 out of five. Its contractual framework was rated 'medium risk', and the document claimed "certain government guarantees contain material qualifications, particularly regarding tax and safety and security".
That is thought to refer to a lack of agreement over a request by Fifa for tax-free status for all football-related activities.
The bid evaluation said: "The bidder has submitted an extensive set of government support documents and contractual hosting agreements, demonstrating the commitment of the relevant authorities and stakeholders.
"However, certain government guarantees, particularly those relating to safety and security and tax, contain certain qualifications which have been duly noted in the legal evaluation.
"While certain contractual matters remain subject to further discussion, the bidder's proactive engagement with Fifa and the substantial lead-in time provide a sound basis for resolving these outstanding issues."

Windsor Park would require 5,000 additional seats to host games at the 2035 World Cup
The Irish Football Association's director of women's football Angela Platt said the organisation is "still working through" plans with the Northern Ireland government to ensure there is funding available to make the necessary upgrades to Windsor Park in time for the 2035 World Cup.
It was confirmed on Monday that Northern Ireland, England, Scotland and Wales, the only bidders for the tournament in nine years' time, had been ratified as co-hosts.
Of the 19 venues proposed by the 'All Together' bid, Belfast's Windsor Park is the sole stadium in Northern Ireland, but would require an additional 5,000 seats to its current capacity of 18,500 as well as changes to the pitch and floodlights.
"We're obviously working with our government partners who've committed their support to help us do that, and we'll continue our endeavours to make sure that we work towards that," Platt told BBC NI's Stephen Watson.
"We know that the Northern Ireland Executive has given a commitment to back us and do whatever they can to support us in our endeavours to make sure we're ready for that hosting of the Women's World Cup in 2035.
Northern Ireland was involved in a similar bid to host games at Euro 2028, but plans for fixtures in Belfast at that tournament fell through when the government said it would not provide funding to redevelop Casement Park in the required timescale.
Platt said that "was in the past" and that the organisation were focused on the work required to avoid any repeat.
"We're still working towards making sure that it does happen and we're positive. We know that the work is there to make sure that it happens," she added.
"It's obviously disappointing when something that people work so hard to put together doesn't come to fruition, but certainly that's in the past for us.
"From our perspective, working for women's football, this is a great opportunity for Northern Ireland to get behind this and actually make sure that we do everything we can to host our Women's World Cup games here."
There is no guarantee that, even as co-hosts, there would an automatic qualification spot for Northern Ireland.
The side last qualified for a major tournament at Euro 2022 and Platt believes bringing the World Cup to the country has the potential to "inspire a new generation".
"I think it can have a huge impact. We've always been blessed that we have had our women's team involved in the Women's Euros in 2022, and through my role, I get to visit other nations hosting tournaments such as this," she said.
"I was in Sydney for the Women's World Cup (2023) and obviously saw the impact hosting a tournament like that had in New Zealand and Australia, and likewise for the Euros in England and Switzerland recently.
"That impact is significant. It's the growth of the game, it's the engagement, it's the legacy. So much positivity can come out of hosting major tournaments and we're excited to play our part in this and it can only have benefits for Northern Ireland in general."

Maximising the societal impact of the tournament, especially combating misogyny, should be a top priority
The announcement that the 2035 Women’s World Cup will be hosted in England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland has finally come and, if we aim high enough, it could have a massive societal impact.
Confirmation was a foregone conclusion – the UK was the only bidder – but that did not mean the submission was complacent or lacked ambition.
This tournament, which will be the largest single-sport event staged in the UK, has the potential to transform women’s football in the four host nations and leave a positive wider imprint.
Andy Burnham said as much in his statement after the announcement, saying it “will reach into communities across the country, bring more people into the game and leave a legacy that lasts long after the final whistle”.
In a world where the manosphere is having an increasingly negative and misogynistic influence on young boys and men, the potential impact of a Women’s World Cup on home soil cannot be underestimated.
It is a large-scale problem. A Guardian article in March highlighted that almost a third of Gen Z men and boys think a wife should obey her husband. A 2025 Movember report found that 63% of young men watch masculinity influencers. In September 2023, a YouGov report found that one in six boys aged six to 15 had a positive opinion of Andrew Tate.
The task for the next eight and a half years, and beyond the tournament, is to ensure the 2035 Women’s World Cup isn’t just a great elite football event but that its impact far beyond is maximised.
“So many people in our country are so connected to football,” said Sue Day, the Football Association’s director of women’s football. “I think we can show the country what women and girls can do and it can almost change the narrative a little bit around gender equality.
“It really can have an impact to the benefit of everyone – boys and men as well as women and girls – because there’s so much in that manosphere space that really doesn’t benefit men and boys just as much as it really doesn’t benefit women and girls.
“On the broadest level, my hope, my aspiration and my belief is that something like this touches the lives of everyone in the country. It shows everyone in the country a different way of doing gender roles.”
It is impossible to predict what scale of change the 2035 Women’s World Cup could inspire, but the scope of the bid reflects lessons learned after England hosted the 2022 Women’s Euros . Then, there was a feeling the FA underestimated the level of growth the women’s game would experience between the bid and the tournament.
Old Trafford was a late addition as host of the opening match , a response to increased interest as the tournament moved nearer. The decision to include four stadiums with capacities of less than 20,000, including Manchester City’s 4,400-seat Academy Stadium and the 7,800-seat Leigh Sports Village, was widely criticised. Of 10 host stadiums in 2022, only Wembley and Old Trafford held more than 33,000.
For the 2035 World Cup, 15 of the 22 stadiums in the bid have a capacity of more than 33,000, and 12 exceed 50,000. The list will be trimmed to about 16, but the decision to have stadiums with much bigger capacities to choose from reflects the need to avoid underestimating where the game will be then and the massively increased interest clubs and councils have in hosting the showpiece women’s tournament. It is also a recognition of the financial and commercial benefits the tournament should bring.
The gravitas of the stadium profiles adds to the broader societal impact this World Cup can have: put it in your biggest and best stadiums, have clubs show they believe in the value of women’s football, and fans will do the same.
It is hard to measure the impact the 2022 Euros in England, and the Lionesses’ historic win, had on views of women’s football in the country or the extent to which that tournament challenged misogynistic ideas and attitudes about women and their place in society. There are things that hint towards a shift in consciousness in both instances, though.
In 2022 it wasn’t until the tournament began that it caught the attention of the wider public. In many respects the buildup flew a little under the radar. By the time England’s defence of their title came around in 2025, it felt as if the wider public were invested in the tournament far earlier, knew the players, and were ready to engage.
Before 2035 there are two Women’s World Cups – next summer’s in Brazil and the 2031 tournament in the US, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica – and the UK nations have a chance to qualify for two Euros. That is a lot of top tournament football to inspire growth and fandom and for the 2035 organisers to build on.
“It will be the most amazing tournament,” Day said, “but it’s also a catalyst for growth and inspiration and something to springboard from. I think we can change the world a little bit with the tournament and we should aim that high. Why wouldn’t we aim that high?”

Caroline Weir says it is "amazing" that Scotland will host the World Cup finals
Scotland captain Caroline Weir says hosting the 2035 Women's World Cup along with England, Northern Ireland and Wales will usher in "an amazing decade of excitement" for the game in her homeland.
World governing body Fifa confirmed on Monday that the United Kingdom will host a football World Cup for the first time since England won the men's tournament on home soil in 1966.
Scotland's national stadium at Hampden Park in Glasgow and Hibernian's Easter Road Stadium in Leith are among 19 venues chosen for the 39-day competition involving 48 teams.
At the age of 31 now, Weir would have to show unusual longevity to still be playing at that point, but she still considers it "amazing news, not just for young players that hope to play there but for us, in this period in between, to develop the women's game in Scotland - and to push it.
"So I think it's amazing news and I think it's going to be an amazing decade of excitement leading into this World Cup".
Andreatta's masterplan to shock Sweden & take Scots to World Cup
The Lyon midfielder has already played for Scotland the only time they have so far qualified for a World Cup finals - in 2019.
"As a young, aspiring footballer watching football on TV growing up, for your home country to actually host a tournament itself, and the World Cup itself, the biggest tournament in football, is the most amazing thing," Weir said.
"So, if I was a 10 or 11 year old girl now, I would be thinking this is the best news ever and I'm going to work and practice and hope that, one day, I am representing Scotland in a home nations tournament playing at Hampden Park in a World Cup for Scotland.
Angie Hind, Scotland Under-23 head coach and Scottish FA player pathway manager, also thinks it will prove inspirational to the young players under her charge.
"If you think of the young players who are involved in our pathway right now, from 13 years old right through the 23s that I take, that's the future," the former Scotland midfielder told BBC Scotland.
"That's very much those players who will be pulling on a Scotland jersey when we are part of that World Cup."
Hind pointed out that it "fits perfectly" with Project 2035, announced this month by SFA and Scottish government, designed to boost the long-term growth of the girls and women's game.
For SFA head of women's and girls football Shirley Martin, it is a "tremendous milestone" considering holding a World Cup had been such "a game changer" for previous hosts.
"Ten years ago, a home World Cup have felt like a dream and now it's happening," she told BBC Radio 5 live. "I think it shows how far women's football has come."
Martin pointed out that the SFA hopes to "double our participation over that time" as well as improving coaching, referees, clubs and facilities - and are already doing so.
However, she admitted: "The one thing we need to do is increase the crowds that come to matches."

Mikel Arteta is hopeful the ­shoulder injury David Raya sustained at Newcastle is not too serious, but confirmed the goalkeeper would miss Tuesday’s Champions League game against Borussia Dortmund.
Raya was forced off in the ­second half of Saturday’s 2-2 draw with a ­suspected dislocated shoulder, ­raising fears he could be sidelined for an extended period. He had an MRI scan on Arsenal’s return to London and was absent from ­training on Monday. Kepa Arrizabalaga is expected to deputise at home to Dortmund.
“He’s not fit for tomorrow, ­unfortunately, but it doesn’t look too serious,” the manager said. “With the pain he was showing immediately after the action we were all quite ­worried, but he seems to be better than what we expected. There’s no need of surgery, which was the main fear.”
Asked whether Raya could play at home to Manchester City on ­Sunday, Arteta said: “Tomorrow we’ll have more tests and we will know. I think we’ve seen what David brings to the team. That’s why we are very ­protective with Kepa and [third-choice] Illan [Meslier]. Everybody needs to be ready because these things happen.”
Dortmund are a point behind Arsenal in the Champions League after three wins from their first four matches and Niko Kovac’s side lead Bayern Munich by two points at the top of the Bundesliga. Arteta said a youthful side expected to feature Jobe Bellingham – who was called up by England for the first time for the most recent international break alongside his brother, Jude – would provide a real test.
“You have to congratulate mum and dad for what they’ve done,” Arteta said of the Bellingham ­brothers. “Two amazing ­footballers, what they’re doing is ­remarkable. So let’s give credit as well to the parents.”

David Raya is Arsenal's first choice goalkeeper and has won the Golden Glove for the last three seasons in the Premier League.
Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya's shoulder injury "doesn't look too serious", but he will miss Tuesday's Champions League against Borussia Dortmund, says Mikel Arteta.
Raya was helped off the pitch in the 70th minute of Arsenal's 2-2 draw at Newcastle on Saturday.
He hurt his left shoulder while claiming a cross and making contact with Newcastle forward William Osula.
"We need some more tests [on Tuesday] but it is quite encouraging," said Gunners boss Arteta.
"He is not fit [to face Dortmund] but it doesn't look too serious."
Arteta said that while the incident looked pretty innocuous the pain his keeper was in made him fear it was a serious injury.
"With the pain that he was showing immediately after the action we were all quite worried but it seems to be better than what we expected," said Arteta.
"When you look at the action it doesn't seem to be much but the extent of the pain that he had and how he was struggling, it was quite worrying.
"We expected something much worse because he could almost not handle the amount of pain he had in that moment.
"The first tests that we have done have shown something that is much more encouraging. He does not need to have surgery which was the worry as that would rule him out for months so let's see."
Raya set to have scan on injury - how much would Arsenal miss him?
Arsenal face Borussia Dortmund, Manchester City , Brentford , Tottenham Hotspur and Real Madrid in their next tranche of matches.
And Raya is huge part of the way that Arsenal play because of his ability with the ball at his feet.
When asked if losing Raya for a long period of time would be the biggest blow to his team, Arteta said: "We have seen what David brings to the team but as well that is why we are very protective with Kepa [Arrizabalaga] and Illan [Meslier].
"Everybody needs to be ready because these things unfortunately happen and now we need to show everyone how well we are protected and the good keepers that we have in Kepa and Illan."

Prior to Monday night, the defender had received 74 yellow cards in the Premier League but had never been sent off - a top-flight record.
But that run came to an end at Brentford as he was given his first red card in his 351st Premier League appearance, although the decision has attracted plenty of debate.
His dismissal crucially means he will miss Sunday's Merseyside derby and also ruined David Moyes' record-breaking night as he took charge of his 593rd game as Everton boss - more than anyone else in the club's history.
The 4-0 loss was also the heaviest defeat Everton have had since Moyes returned to the club at the start of last year.
Tarkowski's dismissal proved a big talking point during and after the match, with opinions split on whether he should have gone. Even Moyes wasn't sure.
He told BBC Match of the Day: "My thoughts at the time, I didn't think it was but when I've looked at it again I think his foot high. Is there enough force for it to be a red card? Not sure about that."
Just 15 minutes after Keane Lewis-Potter scored his second deflected strike of the evening, Everton skipper Tarkowski thundered into a challenge on Brentford 's Yehor Yarmoliuk.
He won the ball but also followed through with the challenge forcefully. Initially, referee Craig Pawson deemed a foul and a yellow card was enough.
But, after an intervention from the video assistant referee (VAR) and studying the replay, Pawson changed the yellow for a red.
The Premier League match centre said on X: "After VAR review, the referee overturned the original decision of yellow card for Tarkowski for the challenge on Yarmoliuk and issued a red card for serious foul play.
"VAR: 'Point of contact is on the shin. He's got speed and intensity. Studs are high.'
"REF: 'After review, Everton No.6 commits a challenge that endangers his opponent's safety, making contact with the studs onto the shin. Cancelling the yellow card - and a red card.'"
Referees are asked to take into account several considerations for what counts as serious foul play including the speed of the challenge, its intensity, force and what degree of control there was.
But, as always, there was plenty of debate about whether it was the correct decision.
BBC Sport's football issues correspondent Dale Johnson, said: "Really not sure about this as a VAR red card.
"Yes, Tarkowski absolutely ticks the boxes for speed and intensity and leading high with studs showing.
"But the question marks are that Tarkowski made only small contact and didn't have a straight leg when he did so.
"Maybe his reputation played a part? Remember, he wrongly escaped a VAR red card against Liverpool for a challenge, which was along the same lines. He won the ball and then followed through into Alexis Mac Allister. Thought that was a far stronger challenge."
BBC Radio 5 Live's - and former Blackburn Rovers striker - Chris Sutton, said on X: "Come on that's not a red… the game's gone."
Former Arsenal striker Alan Smith agreed the decision was harsh. He told Sky Sports: "Ten years ago we wouldn't have looked at it once and now we still [frame] it on the follow-through. I just can't see it.
"Only Tarkowski knows if he wanted to leave it high or if it was natural. The follow-through was just natural momentum.
"There's a bit of anger in there from Tarkowski and it's a little high but only he knows if he wanted to leave a little more on Yarmoliuk there."
Opinion was far from unanimous though, with both pundits in the Sky Sports studio adamant it was a clear red.
Former Liverpool centre-back Jamie Carragher said: "It's a red card. Tarkowski has got previous for tackles like that. He is a 90s defender, he tackles like that.
"He follows through with such force, it is excessive. You want to give him the benefit of the doubt but it's a red card."
He added: "You could argue was it a big enough mistake for VAR to get involved but I think we are splitting hairs. He doesn't need to do this."
While ex-Totenham defender Toby Alderweireld added: "It's a red card, he knows what he is doing. 100%."
Josh, Sheffield: Never a red for Tarkowski and I'm a Liverpool fan. What's he meant to do? Stop momentum. It's a good tackle and the player runs into the natural follow through
Robin, Essex: Another game ruined by VAR! Not straight leg tackle you can surely see he turned his foot around. Poor!
Rob, Manchester: These sorts of VAR decisions are making me turn off football. Why pay all that money to watch arbitrary decisions impact the game?
Lee: It is a sad day when a good tackle gets a player sent off. You slow anything down and dissect it you can find wrongs. Yellow was a bit much and the red ridiculous, we need ex players in the VAR decisions too.
Max, Oldham: What a load of nonsense the red card is. Tarkowski can't stop his momentum. VAR has ruined another game, plus what is the ref doing? He had a chance to stick with the yellow card. Another case of an official who has never played the game.
Paul, St Asaph : Tarkowski has got away with that same foul a few times. Do think he's the type of player to leave one in on purpose.
Anon: Yes it's a red - Tarkowski knows what he's doing, it's frustration and wanting to leave a bit on the player.
Chris, Chelmsford: He does it all the time at the borderline but about time he got one.
Woody, London: Lack of refinement masked as passion, classic Tarkowski tackle there… glad to see him off.
George, Birmingham: Studs up in a tackle, he has to go. A clear red card for me.

Kevin de Bruyne won six Premier League titles, the Champions League, two FA Cups and five League Cups during his time at Manchester City
Kevin de Bruyne says his feelings for Manchester City will "never change" even if the club are stripped of their titles after being found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial rules.
De Bruyne, 35, enjoyed a trophy-laden decade at Etihad Stadium, lifting 16 trophies including the Treble in 2023 before leaving on a free transfer to join Napoli in 2025.
The Belgian returns to City for the second time on Tuesday when Napoli play them in the Champions League.
De Bruyne says he has "nothing but affection" for the club and that "will never change" even if City were forced to give up their domestic titles.
"Of course, it's a lot of things that's been going on but I cannot change anything about that. I am proud of what I have done as a football player and, honestly, this is my club," he said.
"I love the owners, I have talked about a lot of stuff outside football - I have even spoken to [chairman] Khaldoon [Al Mubarak] about how to buy a club."
In September it was revealed that an independent commission found that City had arranged "sham contracts" with a number of commercial partners as part of a scheme to disguise secret funding of more than £830m.
City await any sanctions that may be imposed following their guilty verdict, with possible punishments ranging from a hefty fine, points deductions, relegation from the Premier League and being stripped of titles.
Asserting its innocence, City said it had filed "a comprehensive body of irrefutable evidence [that] exists in support of all of its positions" on 2 October.
Sources have told BBC Sport that City were expected to claim that key sponsorship deals were funded by the Abu Dhabi government, rather than the club's owners, as part of an appeal.
Criticism of City has been intense, but De Bruyne said he can't "change anything" about people calling his former club a "disgrace".
"Of course, in life there are rules, but everybody plays on the limit, I would say, and for me, I played in between the white lines," he said.
"I don't think a lot of people will change in their mind how they view me as a player, or how we played, but everybody has their own opinion."
De Bruyne will be afforded a generous ovation when he returns to Etihad Stadium, having played more than 400 games for City, scoring 108 goals.
After his final home game for the club in May 2025, it was announced that a statue will be built in his honour outside the stadium.

David Raya came off injured during Arsenal's Premier League draw with Newcastle; the Spaniard is the Gunners' undisputed No 1 goalkeeper with Kepa Arrizabalaga and Illan Meslier as back-up options; the 31-year-old got injured at a time where Arsenal have some big games coming up

Mikel Arteta has revealed that David Raya's shoulder injury is not as bad as first feared, but is unsure when the Arsenal goalkeeper will return to action.
Raya came off with a shoulder problem in Saturday's 2-2 draw against Newcastle and there were initial fears that the Spaniard could miss several months if he required surgery.
However, an MRI scan over the weekend has revealed that Raya does not require surgery and while he will miss Tuesday's match with Borussia Dortmund, more scans are needed on Tuesday to understand the full extent of the damage.
"He's not fit for [Dortmund] unfortunately, but it doesn't look too serious," said Arteta.
"We need some more tests tomorrow but it's quite encouraging with the pain he was showing. Immediately after the action, we were quite worried but it's not as bad as we expected.
"We expected something much worse because he could almost not handle the amount of pain he had. The first tests we have done showed something much more encouraging. [On Tuesday] we need to ratify that to give you more specifics.
"There was no need for surgery. That was the main fear, because that would have ruled him out for months. Let's see."
Asked if he could return for Arsenal's big Premier League home game with Manchester City on Sunday, live on Sky Sports, Arteta replied: "Tomorrow we will have more tests. Then you will know."
Raya's injury means Kepa Arrizabalaga and Illan Meslier will compete for the goalkeeper spot at Arsenal until the Spain international returns from his injury.
Kepa was widely regarded as Arsenal's No 2 goalkeeper and replaced Raya at Newcastle off the bench.
However, Meslier started against Fleetwood Town in the Carabao Cup fourth round defeat - which was the last time Raya was rotated out the Arsenal starting line-up.
"I think it's clear for us who is going to play tomorrow," said Arteta about who starts out of Kepa and Meslier.
When asked why Meslier started against Fleetwood, Arteta replied: "Because I want everybody to be part of it and to feel part of it. You need to play, and Illan has been really good with us.
"We believe that it was the right thing to share those minutes, the competition. To give a player that every single day is so consistent, so reliable, so supportive, with the rest of the boys, to have the feeling that we trust him as well."
"Raya's injury is a leveller for the other teams - not that much of a leveller because Arsenal still have some good players. When Chelsea miss a key player like that, that's it for them. But I don't think that's the case for Arsenal, they've got a very good squad.
"But that goalkeeper saves you points. That will be the problem for Arsenal.
"The next five or six games for Arsenal are decisive for them. If they come out of this run of games and they are five or six points clear of the pack, it's impossible for anybody to catch them. Every one of their next five or six games is a difficult football match.
"For me, Raya will be a miss. You'd be more comfortable going into those games with him in goal.
"He's the best goalkeeper in the world, by far, at making angles. He reads the game by always making the right angles.
"A lot of people don't see it. When the ball goes back to the goalkeeper, he'll always be on the right angle to get the ball - and then will always play it into the right player's foot.
"If Declan Rice comes short, he'll play it onto his right foot so the ball can go smoothly out to the right-back. All these little things help.
"And now it looks like Kepa is going to come in - and he's not played for a long time. And all these things have to work for him. That could be a worry for Arsenal."

After every round of Premier League matches this season, BBC football pundit Troy Deeney will give you his team and manager of the week.
Here are this week's choices. Do you agree? Give us your thoughts using the comments form at the bottom of this page.
Konstantinos Tzolakis ( Hull City ): If you watched the Brighton game and wondered how on earth Hull won it was because Konstantinos Tzolakis was in goal. An unbelievable performance with five or six top-class saves. Big moments, big personality, he has stepped up every time. He's been one of the players of the season - I know it's a bit too early to crown people but if it stopped now he has to be goalkeeper of the season.
Janelt scores stunner and Lewis-Potter nets twice as Brentford beat 10-man Everton
James Hill ( Bournemouth ): He backed up getting into the England squad. Sometimes when people get called up they start to get above their stations but he didn't do that at all. He was in a really good state of form. A cheeky assist as well but defensively solid. He has been in my team a few times now - a centre-half who does his job without complaining.
Malick Thiaw ( Newcastle ): He divides opinion but he played really well and got his goal.
Keane Lewis-Potter ( Brentford ): Two goals against Everton and that was before the sending-off of James Tarkowski. Performed well again. Sneaky bargain buy of the century to be honest.
Noah Okafor ( Leeds ): Two goals again. Leeds battered Chelsea and made them look unbelievably average. Nobody has been talking about how sneaky good Leeds have been, some really big performances this season.
Jack Rudoni ( Coventry ): Two assists in a must-win game against Crystal Palace . He stepped up big, fair play to him.
Elliott Anderson ( Manchester City ): The only person who actually showed a pulse in this game. He got a goal and showed pace and showed he wanted to be there. He tried his best to win a game of football.
Luca Williams-Barnett ( Tottenham ): Young man, a with goal and an assist. He just gave Spurs a spark we haven't seen for probably six or seven years now. He gave them that spark instantly and fair play to De Zerbi for putting him in. All the money spent, who knew it would be a home-grown talent in their youth team who would step up and really get the Spurs fans excited.
Florian Wirtz ( Liverpool ): Unbelievable performance. He has had a bit of a purple patch since Jurgen Klopp has taken over Germany. Did really well in terms of finding the gaps, drifting between players and finding through balls and now adding goals. Now we are seeing the player we saw in Germany and I am buzzing for him.
Oli McBurnie ( Hull City ): The man of the moment. He works really hard, he does everything for the team to make sure they are there. He is solid defensively but then he gets two shots and two goals. Top performance from him.
Rio Ngumoha ( Liverpool ): He made Diogo Dalot look like he'd never played a game before, not the fact he has played over 250 games for Manchester United and has gone to World Cups with Portugal and made him look childish, Ran him every time and twisted him inside out and got his goal.

Rangers host Aberdeen in one of two Scottish Premiership games on Tuesday
One between two sides looking to recover from embarrassing home defeats, another a match-up between two teams looking to build on decent away victories.
All four looking to make their game in hand count in Tuesday's Scottish Premiership double-header.
So what's to look out for as second-top Rangers host Aberdeen and second-bottom Hibernian entertain Dundee?
Just over a fortnight ago, a Rangers win over Aberdeen at Ibrox on Tuesday would have seemed a surefire bet.
The Dons went into the international break on the back of a 4-0 thumping at home to a Hibernian side whose victory lifted them above their hosts and left Stephen Robinson's side sitting in second-bottom place.
With his team only two points clear of bottom-placed Kilmarnock, and with the fans having failed to take the Northern Irishman to their heart, the Dons acted immediately to end his eight-month spell in charge.
They acted similarly swiftly to appoint former Luzern head coach Mario Frick as the new man in charge and his promise of "heavy metal football" immediately got a tune out of his players as they blew away Kilmarnock at Rugby Park to end a dismal run of four straight defeats.
Whether or not it was merely the traditional "new manager bounce", only time will tell, but they will certainly be heading to Glasgow with more of a spring in their step after a win that moved them up to eighth.
Given Rangers' two victories over Aberdeen this season, once in the league at Pittodrie and most recently in the League Cup semi-final at Hampden, have been by a single goal, will that renewed confidence and belief from that 4-2 win in Ayrshire be enough to tip the balance of power?
In recent times, Rangers have had a tendency to pass up chances to put pressure on Celtic - and this time a win would take them to within a point of the leaders and reigning champions.
However, Saturday's late winner away to Motherwell suggests the team that Derek McInnes has built is of more sturdy stuff.
That 2-1 win at Fir Park leaves them unbeaten in 13 matches and they are also eight unbeaten at home, having won seven in a row at Ibrox by an aggregate score of 18-2.
McInnes recognises Rangers have yet to dominate games the way he would like, but at least they now appear to have found a way to create the chances that were lacking early in his tenure.
Indeed, Rangers have now scored in every one of their last 27 games in the Premiership and at Fir Park conjured up 29 goal attempts - their highest total in a single league match this season.
To put a spanner in that increasingly well-oiled machine, the Dons will have to end a run of five straight defeats, by an aggregate of 16-2, at Ibrox since their last win there in September 2023.
Overall, they have lost their latest six meetings with the Ibrox side and, to make matters worse, McInnes has won all six of his Premiership home games against Aberdeen since leaving their manager's office, four with Kilmarnock and twice with Heart of Midlothian last season.
Hibs were unable to back-up that aforementioned 4-0 win at Pittodrie as they suffered an identical home hammering against Dundee United on Saturday.
Recently appointed head coach Marink Reedijk admitted he was taken by surprise by what he said was his side's inability to do the "brilliant basics" as he calls them.
A failure to win at home will not have come as a shock to Hibs fans considering they have watched them seven times in a row now at Easter Road without being able to celebrate a victory.
However, this third straight home defeat came on the back of a three-game unbeaten run away from Leith, including that League Cup semi-final derby win over Hearts.
Reedijk refused to concede that Hibs were suffering a home jinx, but he might reconsider if his side falter again on Tuesday considering visitors Dundee are reeling from an even more painful home battering.
Hearts' 8-0 win was the Dark Blues' heaviest-ever top-flight defeat at home and has left head coach Steven Pressley admitting that "at times, I've wanted to crawl under a rock and hide".
While the former Scotland centre-half preferred to shoulder the blame for letting a bit of complacency develop, he echoed his Dutch counterpart by stressing that his side paid for not doing the basics.
In his case, that meant an admission that his squad have a fragile mentality and are not good enough to compete without working their wee cotton socks off.
Pressley is big on psychology, but how will his squad respond to such a public confession at a time when they are visiting a ground where they have not won in 20 visits since October 2001 under Ivano Bonetti?
Indeed, while Dundee are four places and six points above Tuesday's hosts, they have currently lost five of their last seven games on the road and, with Hibs having won 2-1 in the reverse fixture at Dens Park in August, are without a win in five meetings with the Edinburgh side.
To change that sorry trend and continue Hibs' home jinx, they will have to improve on Saturday's statistic of failing to even conjure up an attempt on target.

The tournament will be the first football World Cup to be held in the UK since 1966; 48 teams will be involved, with matches played at19 venues across England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland
The UK has been confirmed as the host of the 2035 Women's World Cup.
The bid was unopposed after FIFA declared it the sole valid bid in April 2025 and ratified it at an Extraordinary FIFA Congress meeting on Monday.
It will be the first time the nation has hosted a football World Cup since the men's World Cup in 1966.
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
The 2035 edition will be the second tournament featuring 48 nations, following 2031, which will be hosted by Costa Rica, Jamaica, Mexico and the United States, whose bid - which also ran unopposed - was also confirmed to be successful.
It will take place across 19 stadiums across 15 cities, with one additional host city and three additional stadiums for future consideration.
Presenting the bid at the FIFA meeting, Sky Sports News presenter - and non-executive FA director - Jess Creighton said: "Welcome to your Women's World Cup 2035. A tournament where we want every team, every fan and every nation to feel at home.
"Across the UK, football has always been about bringing people together - and that's why, in 2035, we'll welcome it the way football always has: by helping everyone feel at home.
"Our ambition is to deliver the most-watched FIFA Women's World Cup ever.
"We're predicting in 2035, there will be more than 3.5bn viewers, and over 4.5m tickets sold."
English Football Association chair Debbie Hewitt addressed the Congress after the bid's success had been confirmed.
"Thank you for your trust and confidence in awarding us the FIFA Women's World Cup 2035," Hewitt said.
"We're deeply honoured by your support and grateful for the opportunity to host the pinnacle of women's football on behalf of the global football family.
"As we said throughout our bid, we want this to be your FIFA Women's World Cup, a World Cup for everyone.
"Together, we will celebrate the power of women's football, inspire the next generation, and unite fans from every corner of the world. We look forward to welcoming you to the United Kingdom in 2035 and just as importantly, to working closely with you all in the years ahead to deliver an exceptional FIFA Women's World Cup that the entire football community can be proud of."
Prime Minister Andy Burnham said: "The world is coming to the United Kingdom. In 2035 the biggest tournament in women's sport will be played in cities across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, bringing visitors, investment and jobs to every part of the country.
"Our players have inspired a generation of girls. In 2035 that generation will watch the best in the world play on their doorstep - and some of them will be on the pitch. But the impact of this World Cup will go much further. It will reach into communities across the country, bring more people into the game and leave a legacy that lasts long after the final whistle."

İstanbul'da bahar havası yerini Balkanlar üzerinden gelen soğuk havaya bıraktı. Lodosun karayele dönmesiyle birlikte sıcaklıklar 12 derece birden düştü. İstanbul'da gece saatlerinde 6 dereceye kadar inen sıcaklığın, bugün gün içinde 7-8 derecelerde olması bekleniyor. Yarın ise gece saatlerinde 0 dereceye kadar düşmesi beklenen sıcaklıkla buzlanma ve don uyarısı yapıldı. Ancak kış havası uzun sürmeyecek. İki günlük soğuk hava dalgasının ardından Perşembe günü rüzgar yeniden lodosa dönecek. İstanbul'da sıcaklık 17-18 dereceye kadar yükselecek. Batı Karadeniz ile yurdun doğusunda ise yoğun kar yağışı beklentisi var.
İstanbul Valiliği'nin sosyal medya hesabından yapılan paylaşımda, mevsim normallerinin üzerinde seyreden hava sıcaklıklarının bugün hissedilir derecede azalmasının beklendiği belirtildi. Hava sıcaklıklarının mevsim normallerinin 6 ile 8 derece altında seyretmesinin beklendiği aktarılan paylaşımda, yarın sabah saatlerinde, şehrin yüksek kesimlerinde hafif buzlanma ve don olayı tahmin edildiği bildirildi.
Paylaşımda, perşembe gününden itibaren ise hava sıcaklıklarının yeniden mevsim normalleri civarına yükselmesinin beklendiği kaydedildi. İstanbul'da 24-26 Kasım tarihleri arasında beklenen hava sıcaklıkları; 24 Kasım Salı en düşük 6 en yüksek 9 derece, 25 Kasım Çarşamba en düşük 0 en yüksek 9 derece, 26 Kasım Perşembe en düşük 1 en yüksek 13 derece
Vatandaşların ve ilgililerin, Meteoroloji Genel Müdürlüğü tarafından yayımlanan hava tahmin raporları ve meteorolojik erken uyarıları takip etmeleri istenen paylaşımda, ani sıcaklık düşüşü, buzlanma ve don olayına karşı tedbirli olmaları gerektiği aktarıldı.
Meteoroloji Genel Müdürlüğü (MGM) tarafından bugün 19 il için sarı kodlu uyarı yapıldı. Giresun, Bayburt, Ordu, Artvin, Gümüşhane, Rize, Samsun, Trabzon için kar ve kuvvetli yağış uyarısı yapılırken, Antalya, Kastamonu, Kayseri, Nevşehir, Niğde, Sakarya, Sivas, Zonguldak, Aksaray, Bartın ve Düzce için fırtına ve kuvvetli yağış uyarısı yapıldı. Marmara'da hissedilen sıcaklık 10 derecenin altında olacak. Trakya bölümü güneşli, Sakarya tarafında hafif yağış var. Perşembe hava yeniden ısınacak. Bursa 10, Çanakkale 10, Kırklareli 8 derece olacak.
İç Anadolu'da daha çok Kırşehir, Sivas, kayseri bölümünde görülecek sağanak yağmur, gece yükseklerde kara dönecek. Ankara 10, Eskişehir 8, Kayseri 16, Konya 17 derece. Ege'de karayelle birlikte hava soğuyor, Manisa parçalı bulutlu 15, Muğla 16 derece. İç Ege boyunca yağmur geçişi var. İzmir parçalı bulutlu ve hava soğuyor. İzmir 17, Afyonkarahisar 11, Uşak 11 derece.
Akdeniz'de gün içinde sağanak yağmur etkili olacak. Adana 20, Kahramanmaraş 17 derece.
Karadeniz'de yoğun yağış etkili olacak. Önce Batı Karadeniz ardından Samsun, Ordu, Tokat ve Doğu Karadeniz'de şiddetli olacak. Bolu, Kastamonu ve 850 metrenin üzerindeki yerlere kar yağacak. Bolu 5, Düzce 7, Trabzon 17, Sinop 11, Rize 17, Samsun 13 derece.
Doğuda özellikle bu akşam ve gece Erzincan, Erzurum, Bingöl boyunca yoğun kar yağışı bekleniyor. Malatya'da yağmur kuvvetli, Güneydoğuda aralıklı yağmurlu, Erzurum 8, Diyarbakır 16 derece. Gece saatlerinde Erzurum ve Kars'ta sıcaklıkların eksiye düşmesi bekleniyor.
